question: what is the highest rated book
sql:
SELECT Book.title, MAX(Review.rating) AS highest_rating 
FROM Book 
JOIN Review ON Book.review_id = Review.id 
GROUP BY Book.id 
ORDER BY highest_rating DESC 
LIMIT 1;
answer: The highest rated book is "Pride and Prejudice" with a rating of 5.

question: Which publisher has the highest average rating few_shot
sql:
SELECT Publisher.name, AVG(Review.rating) AS average_rating
FROM Publisher
JOIN Book ON Publisher.id = Book.publisher_id
JOIN Review ON Book.review_id = Review.id
GROUP BY Publisher.id
ORDER BY average_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;
answer: The publisher with the highest average rating is Penguin Books, with an average rating of 5.0.

question: what is an authors favorite genre
sql:

JOIN book_to_author ON Book.id = book_to_author.book_id 
JOIN Author ON book_to_author.author_id = Author.id 
GROUP BY genre 
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
LIMIT 1;
